title: Arguing your case
focus: 说服 · 承认 · 怀疑 · 强调 · 争论 · 让步 · 角度 · 客观
body:
Words for disagreeing well: pushing your point, admitting when you're wrong, and seeing the other side. Sentences recycle the work words from L6 and the hedges from L14.

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| 说服 | shuōfú | to persuade / convince (someone) | talk someone into yielding |
| 承认 | chéngrèn | to admit / acknowledge (a mistake, a fact) | take on + recognize → admit |
| 怀疑 | huáiyí | to doubt / suspect (that something is so) | doubt held in the heart |
| 强调 | qiángdiào | to emphasize / stress | say in a strong tone |
| 争论 | zhēnglùn | to argue / debate (over an issue) | contend + argue → debate |
| 让步 | ràngbù | to give ground / make a concession | yield a step → concede |
| 角度 | jiǎodù | angle / perspective (look at it from another ___) | degree of angle → perspective |
| 客观 | kèguān | objective / unbiased | guest's view → objective |

## Which word?

**争论 vs 讨论 (L3):** 讨论 is talking a topic over together; 争论 means the sides disagree and each pushes its own view. Angry quarrelling is 吵架.

## Sentences

- 他越强调自己没错，我越怀疑他。 tā yuè qiángdiào zìjǐ méi cuò, wǒ yuè huáiyí tā: The more he stresses he did nothing wrong, the more I suspect him.
- 说实话，我怀疑他根本不想跳槽。 shuō shíhuà, wǒ huáiyí tā gēnběn bù xiǎng tiàocáo: To be honest, I doubt he actually wants to switch jobs.
- 领导一再强调，这个项目必须按时完成。 lǐngdǎo yízài qiángdiào, zhège xiàngmù bìxū ànshí wánchéng: The boss kept stressing that this project has to be finished on time.
- 他终于承认，自己确实不够客观。 tā zhōngyú chéngrèn, zìjǐ quèshí bú gòu kèguān: He finally admitted he really wasn't being objective.
- 换个角度想，他的话似乎也有道理。 huàn ge jiǎodù xiǎng, tā de huà sìhū yě yǒu dàolǐ: Look at it from another angle and what he said seems to make sense too.
- 我们争论了半天，谁也没说服谁。 wǒmen zhēnglùn le bàntiān, shéi yě méi shuōfú shéi: We argued for ages and neither of us convinced the other.
- 他不肯让步，也不承认自己有责任。 tā bù kěn ràngbù, yě bù chéngrèn zìjǐ yǒu zérèn: He won't give ground, and he won't admit any responsibility.
- 你得客观一点，从客户的角度想想。 nǐ děi kèguān yìdiǎn, cóng kèhù de jiǎodù xiǎngxiang: Be a bit more objective and look at it from the client's angle.

cards.Example: 我说服不了他。 wǒ shuōfú bù liǎo tā: I can't convince him
cards.Notes: 说 shuō speak (说话) + 服 fú submit, yield (服气, 佩服; also 衣服) = talk someone into yielding, so persuade. 被说服了 = be convinced. 劝 is gentler: to urge or advise someone.

cards.English: to admit / acknowledge (a mistake, a fact)
cards.Example: 我承认这次是我错了。 wǒ chéngrèn zhè cì shì wǒ cuò le: I admit I was wrong this time
cards.Notes: 承 chéng bear, take on (承担, 承受) + 认 rèn recognize, 讠 speech (认识, 认错) = take on and recognize, so admit a mistake or fact. Shares 认 with 认为; 认错 = admit you were wrong.

cards.English: to doubt / suspect (that something is so)
cards.Example: 我怀疑他根本没看邮件。 wǒ huáiyí tā gēnběn méi kàn yóujiàn: I suspect he didn't even read the email
cards.Notes: 怀 huái bosom, keep in mind, 忄 heart (怀里, 怀念) + 疑 yí doubt (疑问) = hold a doubt in your heart, so doubt or suspect; context decides. Private doubt, unlike 质疑 (voiced challenge).

cards.Example: 他一再强调这只是他个人的看法。 tā yízài qiángdiào zhè zhǐ shì tā gèrén de kànfǎ: He kept stressing that it was just his personal view
cards.Notes: 强 qiáng strong (强大, 坚强) + 调 diào tone, 讠 speech (声调, 语调) = say in a strong tone, so emphasize. 调 is diào here, tiáo in 空调. 一再强调 / 反复强调 = stress again and again.

cards.Example: 他们为这个问题争论了半天。 tāmen wèi zhège wèntí zhēnglùn le bàntiān: They argued about this for ages
cards.Notes: 争 zhēng contend, fight over (竞争, 争吵) + 论 lùn argue, discuss, 讠 speech (讨论, 论文) = contend in argument, so debate a point. Shares 论 with 讨论. vs 吵架 = quarrel angrily.

cards.English: to give ground / make a concession
cards.Example: 双方都得让一步。 shuāngfāng dōu děi ràng yí bù: Both sides have to give a little
cards.Notes: 让 ràng yield, let (让座, 让开) + 步 bù step (跑步, 散步) = yield a step, so make a concession. Separable: 让一步 = give a little ground.

cards.English: angle / perspective (look at it from another ___)
cards.Example: 你换个角度想想。 nǐ huàn ge jiǎodù xiǎngxiang: Try looking at it from another angle
cards.Notes: 角 jiǎo angle, corner, horn (三角, 墙角) + 度 dù degree (温度, 九十度) = degrees of angle, so the angle you look from. 从…的角度来看 = from the perspective of …

cards.Example: 你这么说不太客观。 nǐ zhème shuō bú tài kèguān: That's not very objective of you
cards.Notes: 客 kè guest (客人) + 观 guān view (观点, 参观) = the guest's view: an outsider has no stake, so objective. Mirror: 主观 = the host's view → subjective (主人/客人). Also 乐观/悲观 = happy/sad view.

cards.English: The more he stresses he did nothing wrong, the more I suspect him.
cards.Hanzi: 他越强调自己没错，我越怀疑他。
cards.Pinyin: tā yuè qiángdiào zìjǐ méi cuò, wǒ yuè huáiyí tā.
cards.Notes: 强调 (L17) + 怀疑 (L17). 越…越… = the more … the more …

cards.English: To be honest, I doubt he actually wants to switch jobs.
cards.Hanzi: 说实话，我怀疑他根本不想跳槽。
cards.Pinyin: shuō shíhuà, wǒ huáiyí tā gēnběn bù xiǎng tiàocáo.
cards.Notes: 怀疑 (L17) + 跳槽 (L16) + 说实话 (L1). 根本 + negative = not at all.

cards.English: The boss kept stressing that this project has to be finished on time.
cards.Hanzi: 领导一再强调，这个项目必须按时完成。
cards.Pinyin: lǐngdǎo yízài qiángdiào, zhège xiàngmù bìxū ànshí wánchéng.
cards.Notes: 强调 (L17) + 领导 (L6) + 项目 (L6) + 按时 (L10). 一再 = again and again.

cards.English: He finally admitted he really wasn't being objective.
cards.Hanzi: 他终于承认，自己确实不够客观。
cards.Pinyin: tā zhōngyú chéngrèn, zìjǐ quèshí bú gòu kèguān.

cards.English: Look at it from another angle and what he said seems to make sense too.
cards.Hanzi: 换个角度想，他的话似乎也有道理。
cards.Pinyin: huàn ge jiǎodù xiǎng, tā de huà sìhū yě yǒu dàolǐ.
cards.Notes: 角度 (L17) + 似乎 (L14) + 有道理 (L1). 换个角度 = from a different angle.

cards.English: We argued for ages and neither of us convinced the other.
cards.Hanzi: 我们争论了半天，谁也没说服谁。
cards.Pinyin: wǒmen zhēnglùn le bàntiān, shéi yě méi shuōfú shéi.
cards.Notes: 争论 (L17) + 说服 (L17). 谁也没…谁 = neither … the other.

cards.English: He won't give ground, and he won't admit any responsibility.
cards.Hanzi: 他不肯让步，也不承认自己有责任。
cards.Pinyin: tā bù kěn ràngbù, yě bù chéngrèn zìjǐ yǒu zérèn.
cards.Notes: 让步 (L17) + 承认 (L17) + 责任 (L2). 不肯 = refuses to.

cards.English: Be a bit more objective and look at it from the client's angle.
cards.Hanzi: 你得客观一点，从客户的角度想想。
cards.Pinyin: nǐ děi kèguān yìdiǎn, cóng kèhù de jiǎodù xiǎngxiang.
cards.Notes: 客观 (L17) + 角度 (L17) + 客户 (L6). 从…的角度 = from …'s point of view.
